design-saved.title: Loading and failed are two loose refs
design-saved.detail: DoctypeEditor.vue chooses between loading, failed and the editor from `state` (line 154) and `pageState` (line 160). Loading is `state == null` with no `pageState`; failed is `pageState` set. `reset()` (line ~314) clears both in separate steps, so the page can briefly be in neither.
design-saved.fix: One `load: idle | loading | failed | ready` value that holds the error.

design-saved.title: 403 reason is dropped
design-saved.detail: `failedState` (frontend/src/shell/pageState.ts:34) maps every 403 to `{ name: "noPermission" }` with no message, so the server's reason (design mode on a standard DocType needs developer mode) never reaches the page.
design-saved.fix: Carry the server message into the page state and show it under the title.

design-saved.title: "Loading X…" line is low contrast
design-saved.detail: The shell's "Loading X…" line is `text-ink-gray-5`, about 4.2:1. An existing shell style that #47504 does not restyle (low). https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47504

design-saved.title: No line between the header and the tabs
design-saved.detail: Owner comment: the record page draws a border between header and tabs and the editor did not. EditorTabs.vue is now a record-style tab bar below the page header (all states show it).

design-saved.title: Tab bar is missing during Loading
design-saved.detail: Leftover of https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47644: the tab strip is not shown in the short Loading state, because the tabs do nothing until the content loads (see the loading state).

design-invoice.title: Child columns hide their own loading and failure
design-invoice.detail: childFields.ts reads `saved.meta.value?.fields ?? null` and ignores the loading and error state of `useDoctypeMeta`, so a pending or failed child meta shows the same 'No columns to display' as an empty child (itemsColumnsPending and itemsColumnsFailed look identical).
design-invoice.fix: Read `loading` and `error` from the meta and show a skeleton and a retry.

customize.title: Customize refusal loses the reason
customize.detail: Customize on a core DocType is refused by the server, but `failedState` (shell/pageState.ts:34) shows only 'No permission'. The reason ('core DocType and cannot be customized') is dropped.
customize.fix: Pass the server message to the page state.

customize.title: Screen decided by tab, shown, openChild and state.pending
customize.detail: DoctypeEditor.vue:~45-72 draws Editor, Settings, child preview, Preview or 'Save the DocType first' from four values with nested v-else-if.
customize.fix: One `view` state derived once, with the others as its data.

customize.title: Switching Customize and Design reloads every time
customize.detail: Owner comment: no cache after the second switch. `ModeCache` keeps one load per mode for the open DocType; a save, act or export reload drops both.

customize.title: A cached mode can be stale
customize.detail: Leftover of https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47670: a cached mode can differ from another user's change until the next save, whose version check offers 'reload and reapply'.

selection.title: Selection outlives the thing it points at
selection.detail: `selection` (designCanvas.ts:71) is cleared only by explicit acts (designCanvas.ts:145, `select()` at :167). Undo of an added field or section leaves it set: the canvas shows no ring and the panel falls back to the type list, but the selection is still held and Alt+Arrow shortcuts stay enabled. Redo brings the field back already selected.
selection.fix: Reconcile `selection` with the layout after every edit, undo and redo; clear it when its target is gone.

selection.title: Right panel is a v-if chain
selection.detail: EditorPanel.vue:8-30 chooses FieldPanel, ContainerPanel or the Add field tray from `selectedField`, `container` and `takesOff`. There is no state for 'selection names something that is gone', so ContainerPanel keeps its header and trash button over an empty panel (staleSection).
selection.fix: A `panel: field | container | tray` state computed from a validated selection.

selection.title: Open tab and selection are two values
selection.detail: `openTabName` (designCanvas.ts:73) and `selection` are kept in step by `select()` and `tabOf()`; clicking a tab both opens and selects it, so a field on another tab can be selected only after its tab.
selection.fix: Model the selection as a path (tab, section, column, field).

selection.title: Hover and tab rename are local refs
selection.detail: CanvasColumn.vue:99 keeps `hovered` per column and combines it with `canvas.editable`, selection and drag state; CanvasTabs.vue:96 keeps `renaming` outside the canvas, apart from the selected tab.
selection.fix: Lift hover and rename into the canvas state.

selection.title: Undo of a rename drops the selection
selection.detail: Undo of a rename leaves the selection on the dead new name, so the selection drops and the user is not put back on the old field. Left open by #47503 (b). https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47503

add-field.title: Panel branch hides the search
add-field.detail: The Add a field list is the last v-else of the panel chain (EditorPanel.vue); its search query is local to NewFieldTypes.vue, so it resets whenever the panel switches to a field or container and back.
add-field.fix: Keep the query in the canvas state, or keep the tray mounted.

drag-bin.title: Drag state is written from three places
drag-bin.detail: `canvas.drag = { active, overBin, fieldname }` is set by Sortable events (canvasDrops.ts), a window pointermove listener (FieldBin.vue:65) and read as a guard by `dropField` and `dropOffLayout`; the bin's phrase (remove, take off, hide) is computed in FieldBin.vue separately from what the drop does in canvasDrops.ts. A hidden field dragged over the bin says 'Release to hide' and the drop does nothing.
drag-bin.fix: One drag state machine: idle, dragging(source), overBin(action).

drag-bin.title: Tabs cannot be dragged
drag-bin.detail: CanvasTabs.vue:13 binds `dropTab`, but DRAG_OPTIONS.filter is 'button, input' (canvasDrops.ts:74) and each tab is a button, so a press never starts a drag. Tabs move only through the panel's Move buttons (ContainerPanel.vue:251).
drag-bin.fix: Give tabs a drag handle, or remove the dead `dropTab` binding.

drag-bin.title: Text selects while dragging
drag-bin.detail: Owner comment on overBin: text was selected under a held field, section, column or tab. Now `body:has(.sortable-fallback, .canvas-drag-fallback)` is select-none.

drag-bin.title: A field held on another tab's name does not open the tab
drag-bin.detail: Owner comment on fieldOnOtherTab. `tabDwell.ts` opens the tab after 500 ms on its name and the drag goes on in its canvas (new state switchedTabWhileDragging).

drag-bin.title: No cue while the tab dwell runs
drag-bin.detail: Leftover of https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47601: the tab strip shows nothing during the 500 ms before the tab opens, and on a short tab the bin sits lower than its content.
drag-bin.fix: A hover ring on the tab during the dwell.

drag-bin.title: Escape does not cancel a drag
drag-bin.detail: Leftover of https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47601: Sortable 1.14 in fallback mode has no Escape cancel, so a drag ends only by a drop. Undo after a cross-tab drop restores the field but leaves the new tab open.

finder.title: Finder state is split across two components
finder.detail: DoctypeEditor.vue holds `finderOpen`; EditorFinder.vue holds `query` and `active` and clears them in a watch on `open` (113-119). Empty, results and no results are derived from `items.length`, not named. editorFinder.ts caps each group at 6 with no 'more' hint.
finder.fix: Name the three result states; show a hint when a group is capped.

menus.title: Header menu is built from separate checks
menus.detail: EditorHeader.vue:137-175 builds the menu rows from `props.mode`, `acts.find(...)` and `props.developerMode` (:118); in a child editor `dangerScope` is null (DoctypeEditor.vue:239) and the menu button disappears.
menus.fix: One list of menu rows per mode, built in one place.

menus.title: Remove section has no confirmation
menus.detail: ContainerPanel.vue:277 runs `canvas.remove_section` straight away: the section is removed with no confirmation, while removing a field asks.
menus.fix: Confirm, or rely on undo and say so in a toast.

menus.title: Section ⋯ and drag handle vanish while the menu is open
menus.detail: Owner comment on sectionMenu: both controls now stay while the menu is open, also under a column's ring.

menus.title: No context menu on a section, column or field
menus.detail: Owner comment on sectionMenu: right-click opens the ⋯ menu at the pointer for a section, a column and a field (new states sectionContextMenu, columnContextMenu, fieldContextMenu).

menus.title: Context menu leftovers
menus.detail: Leftover of https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47602: three problems in the shared frappe-ui ContextMenu are tracked in https://github.com/frappe/frappe-ui/issues/1359; the tab strip has no context menu; a read-only canvas shows the browser's own menu.

layouts.title: Open layout comes from a ref plus a fallback
layouts.detail: The layout the canvas draws comes from `wanted` (designCanvas.ts:105, resolved by `existing()`) plus `forNewRecord` (:107). A deleted or conditionless layout falls back silently to the type's default, so deleted and conditionCleared both land on 'Details' with no notice.
layouts.fix: Tell the user which layout opened and why.

layouts.title: A refused layout act has no state
layouts.detail: `runOpenLayoutAct` (layoutDialogs.ts) calls `acts.perform`; an `EditRefused` thrown inside reaches the user only as an error toast through `scope.failed`. AddLayoutDialog.vue:30 `shownRefusal` is unreachable: Create is disabled until both fields are filled, and then `addLayoutRefusal` (layoutMenu.ts:87) cannot return a message.
layouts.fix: Show the refusal in the dialog; delete the unreachable branch.

settings.title: Danger act progress is a promise plus a flag
settings.detail: dangerActs.ts:118-125 sets `edits.locked` only after the dialog closes; between open and confirm a Save can still run, guarded by an error toast (line 120). Each dialog closes before the server call (line 86), so a failed rename or delete shows only a toast and the typed name is lost (renameTaken).
settings.fix: Keep the dialog open in a `working` and `failed` state.

settings.title: Roles load has no loading or failed state
settings.detail: SettingsPermissions.vue:159 loads roles in onMounted with no catch; a failure leaves an empty list and the picker says 'No results'.

settings.title: Tab and place are separate refs
settings.detail: DoctypeEditor.vue:161-162: `tab` and `settingsPlace` are separate refs, written together by `findSetting`; SettingsTab.vue:71-72 treats an empty or unknown section as the first, so 'none chosen' and 'first' are one state.

settings.title: Danger failure text says "Try again." for every status
settings.detail: `httpFailure()` words every failed load as "Could not load X. Try again.", whatever the status. Kept by #47505 as the ticket worded it. https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47505

preview.title: Preview ignores layout loading and failure
preview.detail: PreviewTab.vue:39 and :74 read only `details.layout.value`; `details.loading` and `details.error` are never read. A slow or failed layout shows a blank pane under the picker (layoutLoading and layoutFailed screenshots are identical).
preview.fix: Show a skeleton, an error and a retry.

preview.title: A failed record read looks like an empty form
preview.detail: PreviewTab.vue:100-101 catches the error and emits `pick(null)`, so the user sees 'Previewing an empty form' with no message.
preview.fix: Show the error and keep the picked record.

preview.title: Preview error can show the transport text
preview.detail: When the server gives no reason the failure block can read "GET /path failed with status 403", as the record page does through `errorMessage`. Left open by #47504 (low). https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47504

preview.title: Preview failure text says "Could not load" twice
preview.detail: The failure block reads "Could not load SINV-…. Could not load UI Sales Invoice. Try again." and "Could not load the layout. Could not load the data. Try again.": the block's own lead-in is followed by the transport message, which already says the same. New after #47504 (low).
preview.fix: Show the lead-in or the reason, not both.

child.title: No loading state for the child editor
child.detail: useChildTables.ts:30-34 pushes `table=` to the address before the load returns, and `shown` falls back to the parent until then, so childLoading looks like parentTable.
child.fix: A `loading` state with the child's name.

child.title: A failed child load leaves the page stuck
child.detail: The only handling is a toast (useChildTables.ts:24). The address keeps `table=items` while the parent shows, and clicking 'Edit …' again does nothing because `open()` returns early when the address already matches (line 31).
child.fix: Reset the address on failure or retry from the same click.

condition.title: The rule dialog has no cancel
condition.detail: RuleRow.vue `close()` stages the draft on every close, whether by Done, the X or Escape, when `draft.changed()`. State is spread over `open`, `draft` and the module-level `lastOpened` (line 57), plus ruleDraft.ts `mode`, `value`, `tree`, `code`.
condition.fix: Add a real cancel, or name the dialog's states.

condition.title: Mode and validity are separate flags
condition.detail: ruleDraft.ts: `problem` is computed from `tree` and blocks staging only in `setTree`, not in `setCode` or `switchTo`; `readable` is computed from `value` while `mode` is a separate ref.
condition.fix: One draft state: rules(valid|invalid) or code(readable|not).

save.title: Save status is spread over six flags
save.detail: editorSave.ts keeps `saving` (:68), `banner` (:69, with `failed` and `offers` inside), `lateExports` (:71), `writtenChildren` (:73), `edits.locked` and `edits.dirty`; `canSave` (editorActs.ts) and the Not saved badge (EditorHeader.vue) each read a different subset.
save.fix: One save state: clean, dirty, saving, refused, stale, failed.

save.title: Save errors outlive their edit
save.detail: The banner and `canvas.errors` clear only at save start (editorSave.ts:84-85), on dismiss and after re-apply (:145). After Undo the banner stays and the error shows under a field with nothing staged.
save.fix: Clear an error when its edit is undone.

save.title: A refused rename marks no field
save.detail: The server keys the error to the old name (design_state.py rename_field); the canvas already holds the new name, so `errorsAt` (designCanvas.ts) finds no field and only the banner shows.
save.fix: Key errors by field id, not name.

save.title: Partial Undo does not rebuild the banner
save.detail: After a partial Undo the banner messages are not rebuilt; only the case where no error is left clears the banner. Left open by #47503 (a). https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/47503

carried.title: frappe-ui tokens
carried.detail: Focus ring in dark is 1.54:1; the inactive Code label is too faint; the Dialog top padding is 20px; the Rules|Code track tone; the placeholder gray in both themes.

carried.title: Greptile P2s on #47465
carried.detail: FieldMarks tooltips sit inside inert wrappers; `!important` in the EditorCanvas drag styles.

carried.title: Greptile P2s on #47476
carried.detail: The MOVES label is not translated (fixed in #47503: lazy labels); a 4-line comment; `!important` classes.

carried.title: #47478 differences from the prototype
carried.detail: No per-section collapse chevron; the prototype's data is faked.

carried.title: Module list 500 toast
carried.detail: A failed request shows the raw line 'GET /document/Module%20Def failed with status 500'. The text comes from ui/src/api/envelope.ts:94 (`${where} failed with status ${status}`) when the server sends no message; seen in the New DocType, save, settings and child flows. Candidate fix: a human message per request kind.

carried.title: Toast text is monospace
carried.detail: Success and error toasts look monospace in the save, layouts and settings screenshots, both themes (seen in screenshots; cause not traced in code).

carried.title: Duplicate kind label
carried.detail: The meta line under the title reads 'Custom · Custom · N records' when the module is Custom.

carried.title: Stale banner timestamp
carried.detail: The stale-save banner prints a raw timestamp ('Changed by Administrator at 2026-11-14 11:51:23.170818').
